description: A small sample player: it reads a .wav file from disk and plays it once on a trigger

params.text: Loads the previous .wav file in the same folder
Loads the next .wav file in the same folder
Shifts the playing rate, -5 to +5; at the centre the sample plays at its own rate, and far enough down it plays backwards

inputs.text: A rise here plays the sample once from the beginning

outputs.text: The sample, full scale coming out as 5V; a stereo file is played from its left channel alone

notes: nothing is played until a .wav file is loaded: right-click the panel and choose Load Sample. Until then the display reads R.Click to load, and the two buttons do nothing
the path of the loaded file is kept in the patch and the file is read from disk again when the patch is opened, so moving or renaming it leaves the module with no sample
the sample is played only from a trigger at the input jack; with nothing patched there the module stays silent
menu: Load Sample — opens a file browser for choosing the .wav file to play

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
